Regulations Committee
Agenda

Meeting: 08th meeting
Venue: Committee Room 12
Date: 26 October 2026 (Monday)
Time: 11:00 in the morning

1. Review of matters submitted to the committee:

1.1. Matter submitted concerning the steps needed to maintain the standard of higher education in the Maldives and its credibility.

1.2. Matter sent requesting that the Ministry of Health look into the failure to make the regulations required under Law No. 2024/6 (Food Safety Act).

1.3. Matter sent requesting the committee to take action to review statistics on the regulations that must be formulated under laws passed by the People's Majlis, and to speed up completion of work on regulations for which the deadline given in the law to formulate them has passed.

2. Other matters.
